reports.title: 16 Days of Activism: UNHCR warns over deep funding cuts to vital protection work
reports.summary: Serious funding cuts are severely weakening protection for refugee and stateless women and girls and others at risk of gender-based violence (GBV), like Mariam, who survived a decade of captivity and rape at the hands of Boko Haram militia.

reports.title: DR Congo: Peacekepers step up civilian protection amid fighting in Ituri
reports.summary: United Nations peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have stepped up efforts to protect civilians in Ebola-hit Ituri province following renewed armed clashes in Djugu territory.

reports.title: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians
reports.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.

reports.title: Gaza’s widows raise their families alone: ‘We do our duties twice over, but where are our rights?’
reports.summary: For women in Gaza who lost their husbands in the war, providing for a family no longer means just putting food on the table. Now it also means finding shelter, hauling water and keeping children in school – all from a tent.

reports.title: Yemen war: Emergency aid chief calls for access to war-hit communities
reports.summary: The UN’s top aid official, Tom Fletcher, arrived in Yemen on Wednesday warning that the war there is preventing families from accessing the food and medicine they need to survive, particularly those in Taiz City.

reports.title: World News in Brief: Vaccine crisis in Yemen, aid for Ukraine, another UNRWA staffer killed
reports.summary: More than 364,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since the beginning of August as fighting and insecurity continue, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said on Tuesday.

reports.title: Heavy fighting in Ituri traps DR Congo Ebola responders: WHO
reports.summary: Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has disrupted the vital work of Ebola responders and forced emergency teams to take cover for more than 24 hours.

reports.title: Libya: UN mission urges probe into Benghazi port attacks
reports.summary: The UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) has called for an independent investigation into attacks carried out at Benghazi port and off the coast of the eastern city on Sunday.

reports.title: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen
reports.summary: When fighting suddenly escalated around Taiz, in southwestern Yemen two months ago, midwife Anisa Fadhl had no time to pack a bag before she fled, leaving behind her home and her clinic. Both were later looted and destroyed.

reports.title: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño
reports.summary: Years of insecurity, violence perpetrated by murderous armed gangs and economic instability, combined with displacement, poor agricultural performance and climate shocks, have left millions of Haitians struggling to meet their food needs.

reports.title: West Bank: Record settler attacks mar olive harvest as UN urges Israel to protect farmers
reports.summary: Israeli settlers have carried out more than 400 attacks causing casualties or property damage during this year’s olive harvest in the occupied West Bank – more than in any previous season, UN agencies and humanitarian NGOs said on Friday.

reports.title: Peacekeeping: With 500 paternity and child support claims unresolved, UN scales up accountability
reports.summary: The UN is adding new accountability measures to better support children fathered by peacekeepers, the Under-Secretary-General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, Catherine Pollard, announced Thursday.

reports.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
reports.summary: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.

reports.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties in 2026 already far exceed previous years’ tolls

reports.title: Haiti: ‘Atrocious abuses’ continue as UN warns anti-gang operations must priortise civilian protection
reports.summary: The UN human rights office, OHCHR has urged greater protection for civilians in Haiti amid ongoing “atrocious abuses” committed by gangs and intensified security operations.

reports.title: ‘Hunger should not be a concern’: WFP steps in for families in Kenya who fled Ethiopia violence
reports.summary: The World Food Programme (WFP) is assisting thousands of families who fled recent violence in Ethiopia for the Moyale area in neighbouring Kenya, the UN agency reported on Tuesday.

reports.title: Winter rains deepen Gaza crisis amid restricted access and aid cuts
reports.summary: Gaza is facing a deepening shelter, sanitation and food security crisis as winter rains flood makeshift shelters, destroy scarce food supplies and leave displaced families struggling to stay warm and fed.

reports.summary: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Nadia Murad has spent years telling the world about the atrocities committed against her and the Yazidi community by militants from the terrorist group, ISIL.
